name: Lakeside Grooming
email_note: No public email found after checking: Facebook page About/root (fetched directly via facebookexternalhit UA, no email in meta or About text), thedailygroomer.com directory listing, dogdog.org, BBB profile (BBB notes the business has not responded to BBB requests for background info, consistent with no easily reachable public contact channel), Nextdoor, Yelp (blocked by anti-bot, could not fetch), local.com, loc8nearme, tallahasseedirections.com, usadg.org, threebestrated.com. Left null per no-invention rule.
hours_note: Monday-Friday 6:30 AM - 4:00 PM, Saturday 6:30 AM - 1:00 PM, closed Sunday. Corroborated independently by two separate sources (a general web search summary citing the business's own Facebook page, and tallahasseedirections.com aggregator). Not from a first-party bookable page (no own website), so treated as reasonably reliable but not 100% authoritative.
rating_source: Google (provided/verified in discovery phase, per task brief)
other_platform_ratings_note: Yelp listing shows 30 photos and 44 reviews (separate tally from Google, page itself could not be fetched directly due to anti-bot blocking, only search-result snippets seen). Google (4.6/106) used as the authoritative figure per instructions.
own_site_check: lakesidegrooming.net resolves (HTTP 200 on the domain root, but the /pricing.html path referenced by a directory returns 503 and the server headers show 'server: openresty' plus a Permissions-Policy pointing at *.parklogic.com, i.e. a parked ad-redirect domain, not a real business site). lakesidegrooming.com returns HTTP 404 (Kestrel server, empty parked host). BBB profile lists no website field. No functioning first-party website found; has_own_site confirmed false.
instagram_note: No Instagram account for this business was found despite extensive searching (direct handle guesses, 'Lakeside Grooming Tallahassee instagram' searches, checking the Facebook About section and bio-style content). One strong false-positive was investigated and RULED OUT: @lakeside_dog_grooming (678 followers) is a DIFFERENT business named 'Lakeside Dog Grooming', family-owned since 1996, located in Sterling Heights, MICHIGAN (confirmed via a downloaded post-flyer image showing 'Dresden Subdivision, Sterling Heights 48314' and independently via web search describing that same account as Sterling Heights-based). All 12 photos initially pulled from that handle were discarded in full once this mismatch was discovered. No genuine Instagram for the Tallahassee business exists as far as this research could determine.
facebook_note: Confirmed authentic via first-party fetch (facebookexternalhit user agent): og:description reads 'Lakeside Grooming of Tallahassee, Tallahassee. 473 likes, 3 talking about this, 37 were here. Full service grooming salon, Owner/Stylist-Chantal Celske, Stylists-Tori Grammer and Robin Whitfield.' This is the business's real, low-follower but active Facebook page (posts Reels of groomed dogs). Full photo grid/timeline is not fetchable without login (renders via JS + auth), so only the profile picture and specific post/video permalinks already indexed by search were retrievable.
award_note: The business's own Facebook profile picture is a graphic reading 'Lakeside Grooming of Tallahassee - The Official Community's Choice Awards - Thank You For Your Support! - Best Pet Grooming Company - GET GROOMED!'. Real, first-party trust signal, used as a supporting line in the site copy (not as an unverifiable superlative).

owner.name: Chantal Celske
owner.note: Began grooming professionally in 1993; opened this location as her second salon. Source: business's own 'About the Owners' bio republished on thedailygroomer.com directory listing, and independently corroborated in general web search summaries.

staff.name: Tyler
staff.note: Named directly in a verbatim Google review provided for this build: 'Tyler did a phenomenal job on my double doodle!'. Not present on the (possibly dated) Facebook About staff list, but kept as a real, review-sourced name; used naturally in the testimonial itself rather than asserted as current roster.

services_note: No first-party price list found (no own website beyond a dead/parked domain, no booking platform, no visible price sheet in any fetchable public post). The service categories below are corroborated consistently across multiple independent business-directory descriptions of this exact listing (bathing, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, de-shedding, teeth cleaning, flea/tick treatment). NOTE: thedailygroomer.com's directory template also had 'Boarding / Training / Daycare' amenity tags in its markup, but those specific tags carried Webflow's own 'w-condition-invisible' (hidden/not-applicable) CSS class in the raw HTML, meaning that business explicitly did NOT check those boxes for this listing; they were excluded from the services list below to avoid inventing offerings. No prices are shown on the site since none could be verified; services are listed with 'Call for pricing'.

reviews.text: Lakeside grooming did an amazing job on my mini Goldendoodle! They are so kind, communicate well and very affordable.
Tyler did a phenomenal job on my double doodle! Halloween just around the corner and we are going to show off.
Amazing! They were extremely patient with my dog, who has so many issues he should have a magazine track for himself.
They treat my older Yorkie-Poo, my 15 month old Doodle and me with patience and love every time.
reviews.author: M. B.

photos.source_note: All photos verified as belonging to THIS business (3976 N Monroe St, Tallahassee FL, phone 850-296-4443), sourced two ways: (1) thedailygroomer.com directory listing embeds a photo gallery pulled directly from the business's own Facebook photos (Facebook CDN filename pattern), which was cross-verified as authentic because one of the five images is a photo of the business's actual printed sign/business card showing the exact address and phone number; (2) threebestrated.com directory listing (which explicitly names 'Lakeside Grooming' among its 3 best Tallahassee pet groomers) embeds its own separately-hosted business photo set including an exterior storefront sign photo and two more groomed-dog photos; (3) one additional photo recovered as the video-thumbnail (og:image) of a real Facebook Reel posted by the business's own verified Facebook page (facebook.com/LakesideofTallahasee/videos/1235211240784813/), cropped to remove video letterboxing bars. A same-named but different Sterling-Heights-MI Instagram account's 12 photos were investigated and fully discarded (see instagram_note) once the mismatch was discovered; none of those appear in the final site.

palette_note: Fresh lake-teal palette derived from the business's own real signage (teal-green lettering on a white sign, per the storefront and business-card photos) and the 'Lakeside' name itself, distinct from all previously-used palettes in this repo including teal acero (#4fb8b8) and esmeralda (#2f7d5a). accent-deep #146b74, accent-mid #3f9aa3.
cta_channel: No booking platform found (no Booksy/Square/GlossGenius/etc). CTA is tel:+18502964443 plus a Google Maps directions link, per has_own_site:false and no-booking-platform handling precedent (see the-pink-poodle-tallahassee).
competitor_note: The-pink-poodle-tallahassee (already built in this repo) is a direct competitor in the same city/niche. This build uses a distinct palette (lake-teal vs raspberry-pink), distinct real photos, and distinct copy to avoid any visual or textual overlap.
